mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), which can impair iron absorption and increase risk of anemia; ferrous sulfate may also cause GI irritation that is potentiated by amphotericin B's GI side effects.
action: Monitor hemoglobin, hematocrit, and iron levels regularly during concurrent use; separate administration timing if possible and consider alternative iron formulations or routes if GI tolerability becomes problematic.
